metadata.title: Mid-Century Soul Pop Graphic Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1960s graphic layout featuring a central circular motif of lip prints set against a stylized hourglass-shaped pink field on a solid red background.
triggerTerms: vibrant red and pink graphic layout
excludeWhen: modern minimalist digital aesthetics are requested
muted or pastel color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A bold, flat-color composition dominated by a bright red field. A central pink shape, resembling a stylized hourglass or a curved pedestal, contains a yellow circle. Inside the circle, red lip prints are arranged in a concentric ring. The typography is a heavy, dark slab serif positioned at the top and within the upper pink section.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric arrangement of lip prints within a yellow circle
High-contrast layering of red, pink, and yellow flat shapes
Vertical symmetry in the central graphic element
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy using dark ink on bright fields
coreInvariants: The use of a vibrant red, pink, and yellow color triad
The presence of a circular ring of lip prints
A heavy slab serif typeface for primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central graphic element is a large, vertically oriented pink shape containing a yellow circle, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The yellow circle with red lip prints serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top text, moves down to the secondary text in the pink field, and rests on the circular lip motif.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid red background acts as expansive negative space, framing the central graphic.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all colors with minimal value variation, creating a vibrating pop-art effect.

letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic typeface family using weight and case to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif and wide proportions.
Provides the correct mid-century geometric slab feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a flat graphic background with a solid red field. In the center, place a large pink hourglass-like shape. Inside the lower half of the pink shape, place a bright yellow circle. Arrange a ring of red lip prints (lipstick marks) in a circle within the yellow area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy slab serif text in dark navy or black. Place the primary display text at the top center on the red background. Place the secondary title text centered within the upper portion of the pink shape.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant red?
Are the lip prints arranged in a clear circular pattern?
Is the typography a heavy slab serif?
Is the pink shape vertically symmetrical?

adjustableVariables: Number of lip prints in the circle
Curvature of the pink container shape
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles
Record label logos and catalog numbers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the red and pink backgrounds
Check that the lip prints look like stamps rather than realistic illustrations
Verify the slab serif weight is sufficiently heavy
Confirm the yellow circle is perfectly centered within the pink shape width
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a solid primary color background with a contrasting geometric 'window' shape, a central circular icon motif, and heavy slab serif typography for a 1960s pop-soul aesthetic.
